projects.title: 3-Digit 7-Segment Display PCB with ADC Test Circuit (Designed in Eagle)
projects.description:
Designed and developed a custom 3-digit 7-segment display PCB using Autodesk Eagle, on which a standalone ADC test circuit was implemented and validated.

The PCB was primarily created for driving a 3-digit common-cathode 7-segment display, and the ADC block was added on the same board to test and verify analog signal measurement.
The ADC section was used to read external analog inputs and evaluate signal stability and accuracy before further system integration.

Both the display driver circuitry and ADC test circuit were designed with proper grounding, signal routing, and component placement to ensure reliable operation.

projects.title: 3-Digit 7-Segment Display PCB with EEPROM Test Circuit (Designed in Eagle)
projects.description:
Designed and developed a custom 3-digit 7-segment display PCB using Autodesk Eagle, on which a standalone EEPROM test circuit was implemented and validated.

The PCB was primarily designed to drive a 3-digit common-cathode 7-segment display, and the EEPROM block was added on the same board to test non-volatile data storage functionality.
The EEPROM was used to store and retrieve configuration and test data, ensuring data retention even after power loss.

Both the display driver circuitry and EEPROM test circuit were carefully designed with proper routing, grounding, and connector access to ensure reliable operation and easy microcontroller interfacing.

projects.title: A7670C GSM Module – Outgoing Call Testing using UART
projects.description:
Performed outgoing phone call testing on the A7670C GSM module using UART communication and AT command protocols via Tera Term.

The GSM module was configured over UART, and AT commands were used to dial predefined mobile numbers and control call initiation.
Tera Term was used to send commands, monitor serial responses, and verify successful call setup and network connectivity.

This project focused on validating GSM outgoing call functionality, UART communication reliability, and AT command execution, which are essential for embedded GSM-based alert and notification systems.
